notes.title: The FInal Story Update is now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Apologies for the wait with this one, but the final story update is a real banger! There's a massive amount of new content to play through, and if you were waiting for the game to be complete before starting the game then now's the perfect time to jump in! This update contains:

[list]
[*] A Brand new Dungeon and Island to explore
[*] New enemies to fight
[*] A bunch of new bosses and challenge fights in The Ammonite Arena
[*] 16 New Heart Beat Events, including special Rank 9 Holiday Events for all characters! You're not going to want to miss these.
[*] The silliest final boss battle I have ever written, which is really saying something
[*] Approximately 6 hours worth of new content!
[/list]

I'm extremely happy with how this turned out and I can't wait to hear what you all think of the final story update. I will be listening for feedback and making some small quality of life improvements before the game moves to the final 1.0 release, but all of the core functionality is there and the story is 100% complete. 

Enjoy the update, and if you run into any bugs and errors just let me know and I'll get them fixed ASAP!

Cheers : )
Lach

notes.title: Hotfix 18/8/23
notes.content: Fixed an issue with damage numbers not appearing during Chapter 5 Dragon fight, updated incorrect shop icons.

notes.title: Chapter 5 is out now!
notes.content:
The Chapter 5 update is now live!

Chapter 5 is the biggest update to the game so far and adds a massive amount of new content. It took a little bit longer to develop than I initially anticipated, but I’m extremely happy with how it all turned out and I’m really looking forward to hearing what you all think. The new content includes:

[list]
[*] A class change for each of the four party members (Everyone gets a mech!)
[*] New skills, animations and over 200 new voice lines
[*] 8 new enemy types and 3 new bosses (including one ultra powerful hidden one!)
[*] A new dungeon to explore, The Bandarooi Battlefield
[*] 27 new Heart Beat events! Play a new MMO with Aisha, embark on midnight outings with Heather commit minor crimes with Natara or take part in dangerous experiments with Tabitha and Ellie! 
[*] •	14 Max Heart Minute events! Ashley and Chloe’s silly adventures in the Frakk continue, but they just might wind up crossing paths with the main party sooner or later…
[/list]

All up there’s approximately 4-6hrs worth of new content to play through (depending on your read speed). There are a few minor glitches I’m aware of such as the level display not showing up on the save screen correctly due to S.E.R.A’s class change, but I’ll roll out an update soon that fixes that issue. 

As usual I’ll be uploading balance patches over the next few days, if you found a particular enemy too weak/too strong or think a skill needs buffing/nerfing just let me know either on the Steam Discussion Boards or on our official Discord server.

Thanks again for supporting the game through Early Access, I really enjoy releasing games this way and this just wouldn’t be possible without support from everyone. Only one more chapter to go until the game is complete!

Cheers
Lach

notes.title: Minor Update - 5 New Heart Beat Events
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

5 New Heart Beat Events have been added to the game:

[list]
[*] Ellie Rank 5
[*] Jasmine Rank 5
[*] Jasmine Rank 6
[*] Jasmine Rank 7
[*] Jasmine Rank 8 
[/list]

All up there's approximately 8,000 new words worth of content, and completing Jasmine Rank 8 rewards the player with a brand new piece of equipment. 

We're currently at work on the more substantial Chapter 5 update, which will add new voice acting, entirely new skills and animations for every playable character as well as a lot of story content. This update is still about two months away from being finalised, but we're hard at work and will release the content as soon as it's ready.

If you run into any bugs or erros in the newest build please just let us know on the Steam discussion forums.

Cheers : )
Lach

notes.title: Chapter 4 is Out Now!
notes.content:
Chapter 4 of Robotic Battle Maiden is now live!

This update is absolutely massive and adds approximately 6 hours worth of content to the game, including:



[list]
[*] The fourth dungeon, The Galtissian Outpost
[*] Three new stores
[*] A dozen new equipment items
[*] 28 New Heart Beat Events
[*] 14 New Max Heart Minute Events
[*] A brand new boss
[*] Dungeon events
[*] Silly morning scenes!
[/list]


We're extremely happy with how this update turned out and can't wait to hear your feedback. There will be a smaller update in the next two weeks that will add in 5 additional Heart Beat events, and then the fifth chapter will release two months after that. So far development is going great, and we really appreciate all the kind of messages of support we've received from fans.

Thanks again for all your support, and enjoy the update!

Cheers : )
Lach

notes.title: Chapter 3 is Released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Chapter 3 of [i]My Mad Scientist Roommate Turned Me Into Her Personal Robotic Battle Maiden?!?[/i] is now available! 

This is a really big update that adds 14 new in-game days, or about four hours worth of content. S.E.R.A. and her friends have arrived in Rhyolite Woods, where they go to battle with the fearsome magic user Queen Iliana. Also Ellie gets turned into a cat!

Not only have we added new story content, but we've also listened to feedback and made some tweaks to boss health values in Chapter 1 and 2. The full list of changes is below:

[list]
[*] A brand new dungeon, Rhyolite Woods
[*] 17 new Heart Beat events
[*] New voice lines and attack animations for Neko Ellie
[*] 3 new shops, and new food animations
[*] 12 new enemy types
[*] A boss battle against Queen Iliana featuring new boss mechanics
[*] Updated battle sprite for Kathy featuring entirely redrawn attacks and animations
[*] Two new character sprites (One for a returning character, another for a new character)
[/list]

If you've got any feedback or thought the game was too hard/difficult, just let us know in the discussion boards! So far the reception to the game has been extremely positive, but we're working hard to make the game as good as it possibly can be.

Thanks again, and enjoy Chapter 3!

Cheers
Lach : )
